seoTitle: How to Edit a Shopify Homepage in the Dawn Theme
metaDescription: Customize your Shopify homepage using the Dawn theme editor, from banners and sections to colors, fonts, and navigation menus.
intro: The Dawn theme is one of Shopify's most popular default themes, and customizing it doesn't require any coding thanks to the Shopify 2.0 online store editor. This guide covers changing banners, adding sections, adjusting global styling, and setting up navigation so your storefront looks professional.

steps.heading: Open the theme customizer
steps.body: Access the Shopify Online Store editor for your Dawn theme.

steps.heading: Customize the announcement bar
steps.body: Edit the top announcement bar to highlight promotions or key messages.

steps.heading: Edit the image banner and header
steps.body: Update your homepage banner image and header text to reflect your brand.

steps.heading: Add featured sections
steps.body: Use the drag-and-drop page builder to add sections like featured products and collections.

steps.heading: Adjust global theme settings
steps.body: Change colors, typography, and button styles to match your brand identity.

steps.heading: Save and preview
steps.body: Save your changes and preview the storefront to confirm everything displays as intended.

faq.question: Do I need coding knowledge to customize the Dawn theme?
faq.answer: No, the Shopify 2.0 theme customizer is a drag-and-drop editor designed so you can make changes without writing code.

faq.question: Can I add new sections to my homepage?
faq.answer: Yes, sections like featured products and collections can be added directly through the page builder.

faq.question: How do I change my store's overall color scheme?
faq.answer: Global theme settings let you adjust colors, typography, and button styles across your entire storefront at once.

faq.question: Will my changes go live immediately?
faq.answer: Changes typically need to be saved and published before customers see them, so it's good practice to preview first.
